kids: 🤖 Starlane Trader: your assistant now really talks — with tips in battle, when trading and choosing missions
✈️ Enemy fighters swoop past instead of crashing into you
🎮 Tidier pause and controls screens
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: assistant voice fixed; separate voice and subtitle switches; battle, trading and mission tips; enemy fighters break off earlier and most close calls are near misses; controls page fits all keys.

kids: 🤖 Starlane Trader has a ship’s assistant — give it a name! It warns you and gives tips
🚨 Red alert lights when you’re under attack
⭐ A story adventure: The Vorn Signal — can you defeat the mothership?
🚀 Buy bigger ships, hide cargo from the police, and crack codes with maths
🎯 Tap anything on the radar to see what it is
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: hide/show cockpit screens (✕, F2); named voice assistant with tips and alerts (mute in menu); red alert light (can be turned off); data on this system or the target; prices paid and profit/loss in the market, hold and cockpit; radar target details (tap a blip or N); turn left/right (Q/E — E.C.M. moved to U), roll lock (L) and match station spin (Y); cockpit shakes when hit; ships to buy; hidden cargo compartment and police scans; story campaign; station defences; ore from asteroids; solar flares and ion storms; exploration data; maths challenges for fuel and locked canisters.

kids: 🕳️ Starlane Trader: black holes, pirate minefields and asteroid fields to get through!
🎬 New docking and launch movies — busy hangars, drones and other ships
📰 Planets have news: wars, droughts and festivals change what they pay
🛟 Rescue survivors from escape pods, and earn 11 medals
🔧 Damage stays until you pay to repair it — and a mission report when you dock
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: cockpit cargo and mission screens; full 3D lighting and 3D cockpit on by default; varied, animated cut scenes; TIPS key; stars, moons, planet and black holes on the scanner; mission report on docking; trade hints and local news that change prices; damage persists with repair costs and a damage report; credits on every station screen; asteroid fields, minefields and black holes; escape-pod rescues and medals.

kids: 🚀 Starlane Trader: sit inside a 3D cockpit with side windows and a rear-view mirror
🪐 Planets with oceans, continents, clouds and glowing atmospheres — and they turn!
🛸 Four kinds of space station, and every ship looks a little different
💥 Damaged ships smoke and spark — and your canopy cracks if you take hits
↺ Restart from your last save, or start a whole new career
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: tidier pause menu with Restart (back to last save, or new commander — with a warning if not saved); optional 3D cockpit; textured, rotating planets with atmospheres; four station designs with lights; unique ship fittings; visible damage on ships and on your own canopy.

kids: 🪐 Starlane Trader has a new icon — and an optional solid 3D look with real lighting (turn it on in its pause menu)
🔐 A grown-up now chooses your secret codes for the games
💾 Your progress is backed up automatically
items: 👪 Family codes: a grown-up sets a passphrase (or 6+ digit PIN) and the child’s secret word and 00 number code — stored scrambled in the child’s profile; old shared codes stop working; one-time recovery code.

🛡️ Fair play: one tab at a time, game time can’t be reduced by older files, device-clock checks, hand-edited files detected, new players start locked, 5 automatic backups with restore, and a log in the Parent dashboard.
📱 Help: new “Keeping it fair” and “Parental controls on your devices” guides.
🪐 Starlane Trader: new icon and an optional 3D lighting mode.

kids: 🛸 Starlane Trader: a real flight deck — glowing console keys that tell you what they do when you hover or tap
🌌 A brand-new hyperspace jump: stars stretch into streaks!
🎬 Watch your ship land inside the station hangar — and take off again
🪐 Planets with rings, moons, gas giants and double or triple suns
👀 Side views and an outside camera, speed-up-time, save anywhere, and change any key
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader upgrade: flight-deck console keys with hover help, pause menu (save, settings, key remapping, how-to-play guides), cargo and mission screens in the cockpit, station marker on the scanner, time acceleration, save in flight, side and outside views, new hyperspace effect, docking and launch cut scenes, and varied systems (gas giants, rings, moons, multiple stars, asteroid belts, meteor showers).

kids: 🚀 A HUGE new game: trade, fight and explore a whole galaxy of 160 star systems!
🛸 Dock with spinning space stations — by hand, or let the docking computer do it
🗳️ Special missions can change how a planet is ruled — forever!
💾 Your space career is saved, so you can carry on next time
items: 🚀 New in the secret arcade: Starlane Trader — an original space-trading game in the style of the 1984 wireframe classics, with trading, missions, docking and hyperspace. Your career is saved.

kids: 🔔 The app now tells you when there’s a new version — and what’s new!
items: 🔔 When online, the app checks for a new version and shows what has changed, with simple steps to save and update.

kids: 🧩 A brand-new puzzle game in the secret arcade…

items: ⓘ Hover help: hover over (or tap ⓘ beside) any setting in Admin, the Parent dashboard and Voices, and the main buttons, to see what it does.
🤫 The secret surprise now has two-player modes and one more game…

kids: ✅ Hints and methods now show every single step

items: ✅ Quality check of every question, hint, worked method and lesson. Hints and methods now show EVERY step of the working — for example, in ratio questions, “divide the total by the number of parts” is always shown with the actual sum.
🤫 Three more surprises for players who put the work in…
